assessments.reasoning: Oracle's Java SE 21 JLS introduction identifies Java as a programming language in paragraph jls-1-100. The opening directly supports the descriptive identity at the named edition.

challenge.method: Read the opening paragraph against the separate virtual machine specification citation in jls-1-130 and the account of the Java SE Platform API in jls-1.4-100. Checked which entity each passage names.
challenge.results: The opening names the language directly. The bytecode passage assigns its format to the separate virtual machine specification, and §1.4 associates predefined classes and interfaces with the Platform API.

limitations: The documented identity is Java as named by the Java SE 21 edition of the JLS.
